quest.title: Beauty Expert
quest.description: The Court of Fontaine seems to be holding quite a lively promotion event.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x34075, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Take a look around the Court of Fontaine

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This shop looks popular today... Wonder what the occasion is?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... "Butterfly Dew cosmetics, now on sale"... Huh, looks like it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Sigewinne's here too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Sigewinne!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. I hope you're keeping yourselves fit and healthy?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet we are! So anyway, what are you doing here, Sigewinne?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: The Duke insists I take regular vacations in the Court of Fontaine.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: This one just so happened to coincide with a promotion for a new skincare product, so I came over to take a look. I like to keep up with the latest industry developments when I can, to help me with my magazine articles.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you write for a magazine? Which one?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: It's called "Beautes en fleurs," and it's run by the Fontaine Beauty Association. I've done lots of articles about skincare for them, using the pen name "Romaritime Flower."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, wow! You're "Romaritime Flower"!? If Paimon's not mistaken, you're one of the leading figures in the Fontaine Beauty Association...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Since when did you start reading beauty mags?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wh—What's so weird about that? Everyone loves beauty.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I really like this role. The staff at cosmetics shops are always so polite, and as long as I wear a big smile on my face, I always get the best customer service.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, they sure don't wanna make an enemy of THE Romaritime Flower...

choices.text: So what got you interested in beauty products, Sigewinne?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Obviously, it's because of Sigewinne's love for beauty. Still, a leader of the Beauty Association... that's incredible...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: The truth is, I study this field because I cherish my own appearance. It has nothing to do with being beautiful or not.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh... The words of a master beautician defy comprehension... Oh, wait! You're saying that natural beauty is the highest form of beauty, right?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Not really... Actually, Melusine aesthetics are very different from human ones. We don't view humans based on their appearance.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If I had to describe our approach, I'd say it's based on... "cuteness."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Really?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Yep. Still, I really value my current appearance, and in the process of taking care of it, I've ended up learning quite a lot about skincare and stuff.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Turns out my knowledge and experience is pretty popular with beauty product lovers. It came as a big surprise to me though.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it now. But speaking of your appearance... How come you look human, anyway? Are you, like, only half-Melusine?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, sorry, sorry! That was probably really offensive, wasn't it...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: No, I don't mind — I'm not mixed, though. I made a decision to turn myself into this form, a very long time ago...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If you're curious, I could tell you the story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A shape-shifting story!? Heck yeah, of course we're interested.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Once upon a time...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: ...And so, since then, I've lived my life in human form. Most people who know me just think I was born this way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A witch... a potion... Why does this sound like a fairy tale?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Trust me, it's a true story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Must be the way you told it then... It just sounds so... huh.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're an incredibly kind person, Sigewinne.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Not every Melusine would take human form to save their human friend... That must've been a huge decision.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Treating patients is a doctor's duty. We must always find a way, even when the going gets tough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, it's so crazy that they turned you away just because you were a Melusine. Especially when their daughter was so sick...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Well... Sometimes, appearance can be a real barrier. But that was a long time ago. I like how I look now, anyway.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon too! You're super cute this way!

response.speaker: Calcagni
response.text: Attention customers! Thank you all for waiting. Now, on behalf of our skincare partner, I'm delighted to announce that our exciting new product is now officially on sale!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Well, there we go! Let's have a look, shall we? Paimon, if you wanna buy any skincare products, I'll be happy to give you some suggestions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Personal advice, right from a leader of the Fontaine Beauty Association? What an honor!

response.speaker: Calcagni
response.text: Allow me to introduce our newest skin lotion, Butterfly Dew. I'm sure many of you have already read about this product's trials in the newspapers.

response.speaker: Calcagni
response.text: To say that it improves skin quality is an understatement. This product gets its name from the way it transforms your skin and makes it glow anew, like a butterfly emerging from its chrysalis and spreading its wings for the first time.

response.speaker: Calcagni
response.text: We are thrilled to have the inventor of this fantastic product with us here today — please welcome Mr. Rawat, a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute. Now, without further ado, I'll hand over to Mr. Rawat to tell you all about what Butterfly Dew can do for you!

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Thank you. Hello everyone, I'm Rawat, and I developed Butterfly Dew.

response.speaker: Istress
response.text: Wow, what a looker!

response.speaker: Aurillac
response.text: He's a researcher? Wow, he's really challenging the stereotype...

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Haha, it seems that everyone is surprised by my entrance — or should I say, my appearance?

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: I'm well aware that researchers are generally better known for their brains than their dashing good looks... In that regard, I do believe I break the mold somewhat.

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Of course, appearance is a skin-deep way of defining a person. And yet, one's appearance can be a very real set of shackles, holding a person back in their life.

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: It can rob a young person of their self-confidence when applying for a job, dissuade a young lady from approaching the one she loves... Our actions are at the mercy of our appearance, and we slowly become the very person that the outside world sees us as.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: But what if I told you that those shackles can be broken?

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: If our appearance prevents us from changing, then let us first change our appearance itself!

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Wash away moles, birthmarks, and wrinkles, and they can no longer rob us of our confidence. Replace them with luster and radiance, and we shall never again hang our heads in shame.

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: That is why Butterfly Dew exists. Its mission is to allow us to shed our pupae, undergo a complete metamorphosis, and embrace a new life!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, whether it actually works or not — after that speech, Paimon's already sold!

response.speaker: Istress
response.text: Mr. Rawat, could I ask if you've used this product yourself?

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Of course. I tried it many times while I was testing it — you can consider me a product ambassador.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, then it's sure to work!

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Still, I don't expect to convince you just by blowing my own trumpet. So could I get a volunteer from the audience to try it out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon volunteers!

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Hmm... Oh?

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Ah, what an honor. It appears we have a giant of the Fontaine Beauty Association here with us... In that case, Miss Sigewinne, could we seek your most expert opinion on this product?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Ummm... Sure.

response.speaker: Istress
response.text: Is that "Romaritime Flower"? They say she's the pickiest user of skincare products in all of Fontaine...

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Here you go.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hmm... It's very kind to the skin, and the absorption rate is high... Even for Fontaine, this is a first-rate product.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, now that's high praise!

response.speaker: Customers
response.text: I'll take one! Me, too! Do we get discounts?

response.speaker: Rawat
response.text: Alright, well all that remains for me to say is: Butterfly Dew is now on sale!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The enthusiastic shopping spree rapidly decimates the stocks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Think we should buy a bottle too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, really? ...Well, it's still good to care for your skin though, right? Paimon definitely feels kinda rough from being exposed to the elements all the time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And if you're worried about whether it's the right product for you — well, luckily for us, Sigewinne's here! So we can get an expert consultation.

choices.text: Are you paying for it yourself?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, of course you'd bring up Mora... Fine, Paimon'll pay out of her own pocket, and even share it with you. There, does that sound fair?

choices.text: How'd you become a leader in the Beauty Association?

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: It's an honor to receive such high praise from you. To be honest, I was also hoping you might be able to point out some flaws in the product so I can keep improving it.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: With most skincare products, the pros and cons only become apparent with long-term use.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Yet this one has instant benefits, improving skin quality without any obvious side-effects. It's one of a kind.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Don't worry, though. I plan to keep using it, and I'll publish regular reviews in "Beautes en fleurs" — you can read my thoughts there. All you need to do is subscribe.

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: Oh... I was hoping for a more casual conversation, but you are a Beauty Association leader, after all. I understand if you want to keep this professional.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sigewinne! Ahem... Excuse us, Miss Beauty Expert, but do you think this product is a good choice for me and {M#him}{F#her}?

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Wait. Are you the renowned {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That's right — and by {M#his}{F#her} side, the equally famous Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: #Haha... Well, I don't normally handle customer questions personally, but since it's {NICKNAME} asking, allow me to make an exception.

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: Butterfly Dew is made for all skin types, so no matter who you are, you can rest assured that it will be kind to your skin. If anything, it might be marginally more effective on Fontainian skin, but other than that, it works the same on everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why would it work better on Fontainians?

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: Um... In the interests of protecting my trade secrets, I'm afraid I can't answer that, Miss Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, alright then. How about a friend discount?

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: Save yourself the trouble — I'd be greatly honored to have both of you use my product. Here, take two bottles, for free.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! Paimon's private fund survives!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the catch? Is this a publicity stunt?

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: Haha, I can see why you might think that. But please don't misunderstand — this gift is simply a token of my esteem. There's no business motivation behind it.

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: To me, finding new customers for Butterfly Dew is about meeting kindred spirits — fellow admirers of physical beauty. I consider it a labor of love.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Admirers of physical beauty... Yeesh, that's embarrassing to say out loud. It sounds so shallow...

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: It's nothing to be ashamed of, Miss Paimon. Most people claim to desire inner virtue, but it is still physical appearance that turns their heads.

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: This is a fact of life. It's only natural for people to desire to become beautiful, and that's exactly what inspired me to choose this research direction in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're right! Everyone loves beauty, don't they?

dialogues.speaker: Rawat
dialogues.text: Ah, look at the time... My apologies, but I have other things to attend to. I'll leave you with these two bottles of Butterfly Dew, and I look forward to seeing you again.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Paimon, I'd say there's no need for you and {NICKNAME} to use this product for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why, is there a problem with it?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: The quality is fine, I just think there's room for improvement. I think I could add some ingredients to the mix to make it more effective.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Then... Why didn't you tell Rawat about that?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Researchers are a very special breed of human.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: You can point out their flaws to their face, and they won't mind very much. But if you tell them that someone else could do a better job... Now that'll make them really upset.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: If I'd mentioned it, he probably wouldn't have given you those two bottles for free.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, fair enough, that makes sense...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: If you're interested in the more effective version, I can write up a list of ingredients for you. Just come get me once you've gathered them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #When you say more effective... You mean, it'll make Paimon even prettier? Ooh, {NICKNAME}, how could we say no!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: As for me, it's probably time I got back to the Fortress of Meropide. I mustn't leave the infirmary unattended for too long.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, see you there, then!

choices.text: Well, if you really want this...

talks.objective: Collect the materials on the list
Collect the materials on the list
Go to the Fortress of Meropide

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, the infirmary's packed...

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Please, you have to believe me! I saw it with my own eyes last night, another me! He looked EXACTLY like me!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Got it, okay. I've written down everything you told me. Now, I have a few tests to run. Take a deep breath, and don't worry — it's nothing to be nervous about.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: First, which finger am I holding up?

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Your index finger, but... I'm telling you, my mental state is fine! I'm not crazy!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Very good. Now, onto the next.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Your Grace. It's been a while, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two. Indeed it has. I would offer you some tea, but I'm afraid the timing is unfortunate — duty calls.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No worries, actually, we were looking for Sigewinne. Do you, uh... know what all this is about?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: This inmate came running to guards in a panic, claiming to have seen his exact doppelganger.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A doppelganger? Doesn't that just mean someone else kinda looks like him?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: That's what I thought when the report first reached my desk. But we've inspected our records. No one even vaguely resembles him.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Considering how certain he is of what he saw, I can only surmise that he's having some mental issues. So I brought him for a medical evaluation.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Alright, very good. Take a sip of water and rest for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Evaluation complete. I couldn't find any symptoms pointing to a physical condition.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I see. So, do you still believe there's more likely to be an issue with his mind than his body?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I have to assume so for now. Psychological issues are more difficult to detect. At this stage, we can at least confirm that he is in command of his cognitive faculties.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: The rumor mill will go crazy if word of this gets out... Guards, take him to the ward for a period of observation.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: The Marechaussee Phantom has requested my cooperation on a case, otherwise I'd deal with this myself. Sorry for the trouble, Head Nurse, but I'll have to leave this to you.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: No problem, Your Grace. I'll add him to my observation list.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: By the way, we have a couple of guests here who've made the trip just to see you. I imagine it must be important. You probably won't need to add them to your observation list, though.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Oh! {NICKNAME}, Paimon. It's you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Sigewinne! It's actually not THAT important, but...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'll be in my office if you desperately need me. Goodbye for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, bye-bye!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, so, Sigewinne...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Would you mind waiting for just a moment? I have another patient to see. Just find an empty bed and take a seat, I won't be long.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, sure.

dialogues.speaker: Odilon
dialogues.text: Sigewinne, we've brought him — and he seems to have taken a turn for the worse again.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Okay, don't panic. Let's start by sitting him down here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon had no idea how busy it can get for Sigewinne... Maybe now's not the time to ask for her help with skincare...

choices.text: Patience, Paimon. She'll help us, we just need to wait.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good point... Besides, it might actually be interesting to observe her at work.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: This could hurt, so I suggest you take a deep breath first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did his... face melt!? What happened to him?

response.speaker: Odilon
response.text: It's anyone's guess... His face melted off shortly after arriving at the Fortress, but since he's a serious offender, he can't be allowed out for medical treatment. Best we can do for now is ask the head nurse to give him something to manage the symptoms.

response.speaker: Odilon
response.text: This is gonna be awkward... We still need to bring him to the Marechaussee Phantom for questioning. What if he scares them half to death? Will that be our fault?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Marechaussee Phantom? Does this have something to do with the case Wriothesley's dealing with?

response.speaker: Odilon
response.text: Yep. It was a huge case. They bagged a few dozen crooks in one fell swoop — and this guy's the baddest apple of the bunch. He harmed countless people... And now it looks like it's all finally catching up with him.

response.speaker: Potton
response.text: You done gawking?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Not yet. I need to check the severity of your ulcers to decide the right dosage.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Don't worry, we Melusines have a very different sense of aesthetics from humans. To me, you just look like a little kitty with slightly scruffy fur, but still just as cute.

response.speaker: Potton
response.text: Don't patronize me! Do I look like a kid to you? Just gimme the meds and lemme out of here, I already miss my cell.

response.speaker: Odilon
response.text: Hey, lose the attitude! You dare talk back to our head nurse like that again, your days are numbered!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: It's fine. Okay, I'm going to apply the medication now. Tell me if it hurts, alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look how nice Sigewinne's being! And still he talks to her like that. What a nasty piece of work.

response.speaker: Potton
response.text: Can I leave now?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Wow, not a peep. What a brave little guy.

response.speaker: Odilon
response.text: Thank you, Sigewinne. And I apologize for the trouble.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: #So, {NICKNAME}, Paimon — did you bring the ingredients?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... We did, but we don't wanna interfere or anything... You're busy saving lives here...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Oh, don't be silly. I agreed to it, didn't I? Just hand me the ingredients, and I'll make some time to whip it into the improved version for you.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Take a rest here if you want. Or, if you're not tired, I hear they're holding a new pankration tournament in the Administrative Area.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Or alternatively, is there anything we could help you with, Sigewinne?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Take it as a token of our gratitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Let us help you out. It's the least we can do!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hmm, good point... Kind-hearted humans start to develop "guilt" if they accept free help from others...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Don't worry, I'll take a look at my schedule — I'm sure I can find something to treat this condition.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I gotta warn you though, it'll be tiring work. So I suggest that you take a break first, then come back and see me when you're ready.

choices.text: In the meantime, we could offer to help Sigewinne.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're ready, Sigewinne! What's our first mission?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #I found the perfect job for {NICKNAME}. First, I'd like you to lie down in this bed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What for?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I need you to pretend to be sick.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Is it that difficult? I thought you did a pretty good job last time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, so you knew?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #I sure did. {M#He}{F#She} was way more interesting than the usual malingering inmates, and you played along very well, Paimon. I observed you two for quite a while after that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well this is awkward... But why do you need us to do it again now?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: No time to explain — my next patient will be here any second. Please, just do as I say. You can, uh... pretend like you've got a nasty headache. And throw in some dry heaving for good measure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oookay...

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: *cough* ...Hey Doc, it's me. I'm only here 'cause my mom won't stop pestering me about it — ugh, so annoying...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Your mother has enough on her plate with a busy job. The last thing she needs is to worry about you being sick as well.

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: I know, I know... I shouldn't treat the place like a playground, shouldn't go swimming in the lower levels where we join up with the sea, 'cause it'll give me a cold and distract her from her work...

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: I thought I'd be able to have some fun here at the Fortress for a few days, but it's always "don't do this" and "don't do that."

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Alright, sit yourself down, and I'll take your temperature. Hmm... Your fever still hasn't gone down. Well, here's your medicine. One cup for starters, and we'll see if it helps.

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: But Doc, it's so bitter! Do I really have to drink it? I mean, I'll be fine, right? I've got an uncle who caught a cold — his fever went away on its own after a couple days.

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: Can't you just write me a note saying I'm on the mend? I just need something to keep my mom off my case.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Hmm... I sure can. You're a very brave boy, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: Huh? Brave? What makes you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Well, if you want to rely on your own immune system to clear up your fever, then you'll have to tough it out like this {M#guy}{F#young lady}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *coughing* *retching*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hang in there, {NICKNAME}! Are you gonna puke? Paimon can get you a paper bag!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: As long as you're tough enough to get through the nausea and dizziness caused by the high fever, you'll be right as rain after just a few days' rest.

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: And... if I'm... not tough enough?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, wake up! Wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: ...Put it this way — at least you'll never have to see the doctor again, right?

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: I... Uh, I think maybe I'll take that medicine after all, if that's okay...?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Of course. Here, it's still warm.

dialogues.speaker: Luc
dialogues.text: *glug* Urgh, so bitter... *sobbing*

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: All done. Great job, you two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That kid really doesn't know what's good for him.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: His mother's a guard here. She's been working back-to-back shifts lately, but unfortunately his father's away on a business trip right now. She had no choice but to bring her son here for the time being.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: He was quite happy at first. He seemed to think that the Fortress of Meropide would be all fun and games.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you made us put on that act just to scare a kid into taking his medicine? That's a pretty sneaky trick. Seems like there's a whole side to Sigewinne we never knew about...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: It's a technique I learned from my teacher.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, you had a teacher? Was she a Melusine doctor too?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: She was human. She passed away a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: It's fine. I really liked my teacher, so it's always nice when I get to talk about her with other people.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: She was a traveling doctor. Since she didn't have a clinic, she'd go out and visit her patients wherever they were. Dealing with the badly behaved ones was her specialty.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: She used to say... Ahem, "If you can scare the little brats into taking their medicine, you won't have to hear them wailing and screeching when their condition gets worse."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. She sounds like a pretty strict teacher.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Strict? That's not how my teacher saw it. She thought of herself as "terrifying to kids."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Strange way for a doctor to describe themselves... Now Paimon's curious to know what she looked like.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: As it happens, I actually have a picture of her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow. Yeah, okay, that'll terrify the kids...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Yep. All the children she treated thought she was a witch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why does it almost sound like you're... envious of her...?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Oh, because I am! If she was here, all the children would take their medicine without any need for tricks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A doctor who looks like a witch... True, they wouldn't dare to try anything funny with her around.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Me, on the other hand... It's hopeless — children aren't afraid of me at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's actually a good thing, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Ah, my next patient should be arriving now... Would you mind lending me a hand again?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure thing! On to the next mission!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A dozen or so patients later, Sigewinne is finally done with work for the day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *yawn* Is it night time already? That flew by. You really have a busy job, Sigewinne.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Well, thanks to you two, it was much easier today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Glad we could help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Should we get some rest? It's getting pretty late.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Oh, there is one last thing. I have to keep it confidential, so I usually leave it till after everyone's clocked out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Confidential? Are you sure you can tell us?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: It's fine. You're not living here anymore, so it's okay if you know. All it is, is I have to prepare some ingredients to make healthy meals with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you mean... THOSE healthy meals?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The ones that magically appear on the third day?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: My patients refuse to eat any healthy meals I prepare in front of them. So, I have to prep the ingredients in secret, then let the chef at the Coupon Cafeteria handle the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Considering even the chef's version makes people uneasy, it really makes you wonder what's in it...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: You wanna find out? I can teach you how to make it. That way, if you ever suffer from exhaustion on your future travels, you can prepare a healthy meal for yourself. It's really good for you, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... Sure. Guess we can help out one more time.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: The ingredients are ready. Now, put them on the table, and add them in the order I tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: First we add this special Slime Condensate. Stir thoroughly, then pour it in. See that? It adds elasticity. Looks just like tasty jelly, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it really does! ...Until you remember it's Slime Condensate.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Next up, Xenochromatic Crystals. You wanna crush them up into a fine powder — like powdered sugar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, are those from Fontemer Aberrants? Are you sure they're edible?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Finally, we'll need some high-protein meat. Frogs are an excellent choice. You just need to clean their innards, and then you're left with some lovely, tender meat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, frogs, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm. And we're done. All that's left now is to pack them into lunchboxes and hand them to Wolsey.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Yesterday in the production zone, I noticed an inmate who's been working for two days straight. That means it's a healthy meal for him tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sigewinne really does have the inmates' best interests at heart.

talks.objective: Give the prepared ingredients to Wolsey

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: Ah, Head Nurse! Got some extras for me?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Just the one today. The serial number's on the lid.

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: Sounds good! I'll make sure it gets delivered.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like they're talking in code.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: Oh, it's no trouble at all. I only wish I could do more. You work so hard for all our sakes... I'd happily lose a little sleep if it meant helping you out.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: That won't do. If you reduce your sleeping hours any further, your health will start to suffer.

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: Hmm... Alright, nurse's orders — I'll do as I'm told. But you take care of yourself too.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Well, I'm done with work for today. Thanks for helping out, you two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like the guards and staff here have a lot of respect for you, Sigewinne. In just one day of helping you with your work, it feels like we've done a lot for the Fortress.

dialogues.speaker: Courbevoie
dialogues.text: Head Nurse! Please, wait! I'm sorry to disturb you this late at night, but I think you'll agree this is urgent.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Okay, just relax and catch your breath. What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Courbevoie
dialogues.text: The guard at the observation ward, Odilon, he told me to pass on a message to you. One of the inmates there, the guy suffering from possible hallucinations... Well, he seems to have made a sudden recovery. And now he wants to apply for permission to leave the ward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Already?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: You were right to tell me. I'll have to examine him and make sure he's well before we discharge him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we've got one job as medical assistants left. We'll come with you.

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Ah, Head Nurse, you're finally here. I'm so sorry for the all trouble I've caused you, but I believe I've now made a full recovery.

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: After giving it some thought, I'm sure that I was probably just seeing things. Stress-related, I imagine. I'd been working long hours, so I definitely wasn't in the best state of mind.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I totally understand. Still, I have to give you an examination before I can discharge you, okay? So take a deep breath, and don't be nervous. It'll be the exact same procedure as we did this morning. We can start whenever you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Uhh... Again, so sorry — I was in such a state this morning, I barely recall anything... Would you mind taking me through it again?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Not at all, it's a lot to remember. First up, we have a little cognitive test. Just concentrate, and you'll be fine. To start with — which finger am I holding up?

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Your pinky.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Under Sigewinne's guidance, Erick quickly completes the full series of tests.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Alright, all indicators seem normal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it was a stress-induced hallucination after all?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Well, we've certainly had previous cases of mental illness caused by overwork, which is why I carefully observe everyone in the production zone. I wonder how I managed to miss the signs this time...?

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Please, Head Nurse, you shouldn't blame yourself! I'm just still adapting, that's all. Pushed myself too hard and I guess I couldn't take it.

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Thanks for looking after me. I'll be as good as new after a good night's sleep, and if you can give me the okay, I know I'll sleep better back in my good old dorm...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: It can be difficult to relax in an unfamiliar environment... Alright then, you can leave the ward.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I suggest you take two days off to focus on your recovery. I'll take you off the observation list for now, so you're officially discharged.

dialogues.speaker: Erick
dialogues.text: Great. I can't thank you enough, Head Nurse.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Mr. Odilon, could you escort him back?

dialogues.speaker: Odilon
dialogues.text: Of course. I'm on guard duty in the Administrative Area tonight, so nothing will go wrong. You have my word.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess you're finally done for the day now, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Yep... Ah, but I still haven't gotten around to making that improved lotion for you yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No rush! Seriously, it's super late now. You should go get some rest too!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Tomorrow it is, then. Good night, {NICKNAME}. Good night, Paimon. Hope you sleep well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, don't you worry, we will! After a productive day of work, we're both gonna sleep like a log!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Sigewinne.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, sleep tight, Sigewinne! See ya tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Aurillac
dialogues.text: I'm buying for a friend, but just wanna check — this is designed for both women and men, right?

dialogues.speaker: Istress
dialogues.text: I was looking to switch up my skincare routine anyway. I'm gonna try this out as soon as I get home tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Anais
dialogues.text: I wish I'd saved up my pocket money...

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Stocks are running low, so purchase soon to avoid disappointment!

dialogues.speaker: Lazare
dialogues.text: This is the observation ward. If you want to visit a patient, you'll need authorization from the head nurse.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Just up ahead, {NICKNAME}! The ingredients for Sigewinne should be nearby!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great, that's everything! Let's head to the Fortress of Meropide.
